text: Albanian licence plates either have **blue strips** on both sides or a single **red strip** on the left side.

NOTE: Albania is the only European country with red on the left side of the licence plate. Furthermore, Italian licence plates also have blue strips on both sides, however Italian front plates are distinctly shorter.
text_zh: 阿爾巴尼亞的車牌 (licence plate) 兩側有**藍色條紋**，或左側有單一**紅色條紋**。
注意：阿爾巴尼亞是唯一車牌 (licence plate) 左側有紅色的歐洲國家。此外，義大利車牌 (licence plate) 兩側也有藍色條紋，但義大利前車牌明顯較短。

text: Austria has long, **white** licence plates with the standard **blue EU strip** on the left.
NOTE: Italian plates have two blue strips, on both sides of the plate. Italian plates also tend to be noticeably shorter.
Swiss plates are long and white, but lack the blue strip.
text_zh: 奧地利使用長條形**白色**車牌，左側有標準的**藍色歐盟條紋**。
註：義大利車牌的兩側都有藍色條紋。義大利車牌通常也明顯較短。
瑞士車牌為長條形白色，但沒有藍色條紋。

text: Licence plates in Brazil were **white **until 2018. Now, a **white plate with a blue stripe** on top is used. Red is still used for commercial vehicles.
text_zh: 巴西的車牌在 2018 年前為**白色**。現在則使用頂部帶有**藍色條紋的白底車牌**。紅色車牌仍用於商業車輛。

text: The United States and Canada will usually have **short license plates**. Europe usually uses a **long license plate** which will also have a blue strip on the side.
NOTE: Each province has its own designs. An overview of the specific designs in each province can be seen in step 2.
text_zh: 美國和加拿大通常使用**短車牌**。歐洲通常使用**長車牌**，而且側邊會有藍色條紋。
註：每個省份都有自己的設計。步驟 2 可以看到各省具體設計的總覽。

text: Each province has its own **unique licence plates**, some recognizable from afar even when blurred. Multiple provinces **do not **require front plates, which can be useful when deciding between provinces.

NOTE: Since 2019, front plates are no longer required in New Brunswick. However, you should still expect to see them in older coverage. As well, all commercial vehicles in Newfoundland and Labrador are required to use front plates, and so it is possible to see them on vans and pickup trucks.
_You can click on the image to enlarge it._
text_zh: 每個省份都有自己**獨特的車牌**，有些即使經過模糊處理也能從遠處識別。許多省份**並不 **強制安裝前車牌，這在區分不同省份時非常有用。
註：自 2019 年起，紐布倫斯威克省不再強制要求安裝前車牌。不過在較舊的街景覆蓋中仍可能看到前車牌。此外，紐芬蘭與拉布拉多省的所有商業車輛都必須使用前車牌，因此在廂型車和皮卡車上可能會看到它們。
_點擊圖片可放大。_

text: Modern French plates are long and white, with **blue strips on both sides** of the plate. The left strip will be more visible than the right strip.
Some older French plates lack the right blue strip, with the rear plate being **yellow**. These are very rare in newer coverage.
NOTE: Italian plates also have two blue strips, which are equally visible. In addition, Italian front plates are considerably shorter.
text_zh: 現代的法國車牌長且為白色，車牌**兩側都有藍色條帶**。左側的條帶會比右側的條帶更明顯。
一些較舊的法國車牌缺少右側的藍色條帶，且後車牌是**黃色**的。這些在較新的覆蓋中非常罕見。
注意：義大利車牌也有兩道藍色條紋，且兩邊一樣明顯。此外，義大利的前車牌顯得短得多。

text: Each department has an assigned number to it, arranged mostly [alphabetically](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Departments_of_France#Current_departments). This is most useful in postal codes, consisting of 5 digits, the first two representing the department they’re in.
NOTE: the same regional codes are used inside the right blue strip on [licence plates](https://maps.app.goo.gl/hdSg7fcVKbUGPcjP8).
text_zh: 每個省份都有一個指定的編號，大多按[字母順序](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Departments_of_France#Current_departments)排列。這在郵遞區號中最有用，郵遞區號由 5 位數組成，前兩位數代表他們所在的省份。
注意：相同的區域代碼也用於[車牌](https://maps.app.goo.gl/hdSg7fcVKbUGPcjP8)右側的藍色條帶內。

text: Indonesian licence plates are black with white letters. The letters usually appear as **three white sections** through the blur.
Commercial vehicles use yellow licence plates.
Plates in newer coverage can be [white](https://maps.app.goo.gl/41BknjygGkkbi1CJ6) too.
NOTE: Malaysian licence plates are also black, but generally have two white sections.
text_zh: 印尼車牌為黑色配白字。透過模糊效果，字母通常會呈現**三個白色區塊**。
商業車輛使用黃色車牌。
較新街景覆蓋中的車牌也可以是[白色](https://maps.app.goo.gl/41BknjygGkkbi1CJ6)的。
注意：馬來西亞車牌也是黑色的，但通常只有兩個白色區塊。

text: Motorcycles in Indonesia have **front** licence plates, as opposed to other south-east Asian countries which do not.
text_zh: 印尼的摩托車有**前方**車牌，這與其他不設前方車牌的東南亞國家不同。

text: Contrary to most European licence plates, Italian plates have blue strips on **either side** of the plate. Furthermore, the front plate is distinctly **shorter** than most European plates, which in combination with the two strips, makes it unique.
NOTE: Albanian licence plates also have two blue strips, and French licence plates have a smaller strip on the right. However, neither Albanian nor French front plates are short.
text_zh: 與大多數歐洲車牌相反，義大利車牌在車牌的**兩側**都有藍色條紋。此外，前車牌明顯比大多數歐洲車牌**短**，這與兩條藍色條紋結合，使其成為獨一無二的特徵。
注意：阿爾巴尼亞車牌也有兩條藍色條紋，法國車牌右側則有一個較小的條紋。然而，阿爾巴尼亞和法國的前車牌都不短。

text: Kenya uses **long white** front licence plates. The rear counterpart is **square** and **yellow**.
text_zh: 肯亞使用**長型白色**前車牌。後車牌則是**方形**且為**黃色**。

text: Malaysian licence plates are **black** and generally have **two** white sections. These are visible even when blurred.
NOTE: Indonesian licence plates can also be black, but they will have **three** white sections.
text_zh: 馬來西亞車牌是**黑色**的，通常有**兩個**白色區塊。即使車牌模糊，這些特徵依然清晰可見。
注意：印尼車牌也可能是黑色的，但它們會有**三個**白色區塊。

text: Montenegro uses the standard European plate with a blue strip, and the Montenegro coat of arms on a **red circle**. The red circle is visible through the blur.
NOTE: The white section of Albanian licence plates do not have a red circle.
text_zh: 蒙特內哥羅使用帶有藍色條紋的標準歐洲車牌，**紅圈**內有蒙特內哥羅國徽。紅圈透過模糊效果依稀可見。
注意：阿爾巴尼亞車牌的白色部分沒有紅圈。

text: North Macedonian licence plates are **white** and sometimes have the standard European blue strip on the left. They also have a noticeable **red block** near the left side of the licence plate.
NOTE: Serbia will almost always have a blue strip on their licence plates.
text_zh: 北馬其頓車牌是**白色**的，左側有時會有標準的歐洲藍色條紋。它們在車牌左側附近也有一個明顯的**紅色方塊**。
備註：塞爾維亞的車牌幾乎總是會有藍色條紋。

text: Panama features short licence plates, most commonly white with a horizontal **turquoise strip **on the** top**. Rarely, the strip can have [other colours](https://goo.gl/maps/xCKZgTN28Dzp9W8w6).
Front plates are **not **required in Panama.
text_zh: 巴拿馬的車牌較短，最常見的是白色，**頂部**有一條水平的**土耳其藍色條紋**。少數情況下，條紋可能會有[其他顏色](https://goo.gl/maps/xCKZgTN28Dzp9W8w6)。
巴拿馬**不**強制要求懸掛前車牌。

text: The first digit of taxi and bus licence plates can be used to regionguess Panama.
NOTE: Cars travel, so they are not always reliable, especially outside of cities.
text_zh: 計程車與公車車牌的第一位數字可以用來判斷巴拿馬的區域。
注意：車輛會移動，所以不一定完全可靠，特別是在城市外面。

text: Russian licence plates are **fully white** with black text.
NOTE: Most European counterparts will feature a blue strip on the left hand side.
text_zh: 俄羅斯車牌為**全白色**，配有黑色文字。
注意：大多數歐洲對應車型左側都會有藍色飾帶。

text: Rwanda uses long **white front** and **yellow back** licence plates.
text_zh: 盧安達使用長型的**白色前車牌**和**黃色後車牌**。

text: Serbian licence plates are white with a **blue strip** on the left. Agricultural plates, on vehicles such as tractors, are **green**.
NOTE: Croatian and North Macedonian plates typically do not have a blue strip.
text_zh: 塞爾維亞車牌是白色的，左側帶有**藍色條紋**。農用車輛（如拖拉機）的車牌則是**綠色**的。
注意：克羅埃西亞和北馬其頓的車牌通常沒有藍色條紋。

text: The United States and Canada will usually have **short license plates**. Europe usually uses a **long license plate** which will also have a blue strip on the side.
NOTE: Each state has its own designs. An overview of the specific designs in each state can be seen in step 2.
text_zh: 美國和加拿大通常使用**短車牌**。歐洲通常使用**長車牌**，而且側邊會有藍色條紋。
注意：每個州都有自己的設計。各州具體設計的概述可以在步驟 2 中看到。

text: The US, as well as most of the Americas, uses short license plates, in contrast to longer European ones. Around half of the states also do **not require front plates**, which can also be useful in determining the state.
_You can click on the image to enlarge it._
text_zh: 美國以及多數美洲地區使用較短的車牌，這與較長的歐洲車牌形成對比。大約有一半的州也**不強制要求懸掛前車牌**，這對於判定美國各州也很有幫助。
_點擊圖片可放大。_

text: Each US state has their own** unique license plate **design. Some of these are recognizable through the blur, and are thus worth learning.
text_zh: 美國每個州都有自己**獨特的車牌**設計。其中有些設計即使透過模糊處理也能辨認出來，因此很值得學習。

text: The most common and recognisable Alaskan licence plate is **all yellow**. In Generation 4 coverage you can also get a plate with a large orange circle in the middle. Front plates are required in Alaska.
text_zh: 最常見且最容易辨識的阿拉斯加車牌是**全黃色**的。在第四代街景覆蓋中，你也會看到車牌中間有一個大橘色圓圈。阿拉斯加要求車輛懸掛前車牌。

text: Andorran licence plates have an **orange dot** on the left side and can be regularly found throughout the country.
NOTE: Within Europe, this plate is unique to Andorra.
text_zh: 安道爾的車牌左側有一個**橘色圓點**，在全國各地都能經常看到。
注意：在歐洲境內，這種車牌是安道爾獨有的。

text: Argentina uses two types of licence plates: a black one, which will be visible on street view with a **black dot** in the middle, and a white one with a **blue bar** at the top.
NOTE: The black dot can only be found on Argentinian licence plates, while the blue bar can be found in Brazil as well.
text_zh: 阿根廷使用兩種車牌：一種是黑色車牌，在街景中會看到中間有一個 **黑點**；另一種是白色車牌，頂部有一條 **藍條**。
注意：黑點只會出現在阿根廷車牌上，而藍條則在巴西也能找到。

text: Different states use **different **licence plate designs, which can be somewhat visible through the blur.
text_zh: 各州使用**不同**的車牌設計，這些設計在模糊中仍可略微辨識。

text: Bangladeshi licence plates are either **white**, **black** or **turquoise**.
NOTE: The turquoise plate can only be found in Bangladesh.
text_zh: 孟加拉的車牌是**白色**、**黑色**或**綠松色**。
註：綠松色車牌僅能在孟加拉找到。

text: Licence plates in Belgium use** red text**. You can recognise this distinct colour even through the blur.
text_zh: 比利時的車牌使用**紅字**。即使透過模糊處理，你也能辨認出這種獨特的顏色。

text: Bermudan licence plates are all-white, fairly long, and with black digits, somewhat contained to the middle of the plate.
text_zh: 百慕達的車牌全白、相當長，帶有黑色數字，數字稍微集中在車牌中間。

text: Licence plates in Bhutan are almost always **red** and can easily be seen on vehicles.
NOTE: Within Asia, Bhutan is the only country that uses full red licence plates.
text_zh: 不丹的車牌幾乎總是**紅色**的，在車輛上很容易看到。
注意：在亞洲，不丹是唯一使用全紅車牌的國家。

text: Taxis in Bhutan have **yellow** licence plates and **yellow** roofs.
text_zh: 不丹的計程車有**黃色**車牌和**黃色**車頂。

text: Bolivia has **short, white licence plates** with blue text. The blue text can be hard to see through the blur, so plates might appear as plain white.
text_zh: 玻利維亞擁有帶有藍字的**短版白色車牌**。透過模糊處理可能很難看清藍字，因此車牌看起來可能只是純白色。

text: **Random small blurs** are common in Botswana’s coverage. These blurs are similar to the ones found on licence plates and faces, but they cover seemingly random parts of the panorama instead. This is especially noticeable in urban areas, and mostly absent on more rural roads.
text_zh: **隨機的小型模糊**在波札那的街景覆蓋中很常見。這些模糊類似於在車牌和人臉上看到的模糊，但它們涵蓋的全景位置看似隨機。這在城鎮區域特別明顯，而在較偏遠的鄉村道路上則幾乎沒有。

text: Bulgarian licence plates have the typical European design, with the blue strip on the left.
text_zh: 保加利亞車牌具有典型的歐洲設計，左側有藍色條帶。

text: Licence plates are **white** with **blue** letters. The blue sheen of the letters can be hard to see through the blur, and the plates might appear as plain white.
Plates on government vehicles are [green](https://goo.gl/maps/Y5GJLe2TPsuKVnts5).
text_zh: 車牌是**白色**的，帶有**藍色**字母。字母的藍色光澤在模糊處理後可能很難看清，車牌看起來可能就像純白色。
公務車輛的車牌是[綠色](https://goo.gl/maps/Y5GJLe2TPsuKVnts5)。

text: Regular vehicles have **white** licence plates, while commercial and taxi vehicles have **orange** plates.
NOTE: Orange plates can also be seen in Ecuador. Brazilian commercial plates are red, but can look similar in some lighting.
text_zh: 一般車輛使用**白色**車牌，而商業車輛和計程車使用**橘色**車牌。
注意：厄瓜多也能看到橘色車牌。巴西的商業車牌是紅色的，但在某些光線下看起來會很相似。

text: Chinese licence plates are **blue** with white text.
text_zh: 中國車牌是**藍色**配白字。

text: Christmas Island has **yellow** licence plates.
text_zh: 聖誕島擁有**黃色**車牌。

text: Colombian licence plates are typically **yellow**.
NOTE: Within South America, yellow licence plates are almost exclusively found in Colombia.
text_zh: 哥倫比亞車牌通常是**黃色**的。
註：在南美洲內，黃色車牌幾乎只在哥倫比亞找到。

text: Colombian taxis are always this **pastel yellow** colour. As opposed to private vehicles, they have white licence plates, which are often printed on the side and roof. If unblurred, you will often see the city name.
NOTE: Ecuadorian taxis may look similar. However, they use a slightly more saturated yellow and typically have orange plates.
text_zh: 哥倫比亞計程車總是這種**粉嫩黃色**。與私人車輛相反，它們使用白色車牌，通常會印在車身側邊與車頂上。如果沒有模糊，你通常會看到城市名稱。
註：厄瓜多計程車看起來可能很像。然而，它們使用的是飽和度稍高的黃色，且通常使用橘色車牌。

text: Costa Rican licence plates are typically short and white with **blue text**, giving them a light blue tint through the blur.
text_zh: 哥斯大黎加車牌通常很短且為白色，配有**藍色文字**，透過模糊處理後會呈現淡淡的藍色。

text: Croatia has long, **white licence plates**. Some plates have a blue strip on the left, some are fully white. Most cars seen in Generation 3 will not feature a blue strip on their licence plates. In addition, there is a mix of cars with or without blue strips in Generation 4, with blue strips more common on newer cars.
NOTE: Blue strips are more common along the coast due to travelling tourists from other EU countries such as Italy.
text_zh: 克羅埃西亞擁有長條形的**白色車牌**。有些車牌左側有藍色條紋，有些則全白。在第 3 代相機世代看到的絕大多數汽車車牌上都沒有藍色條紋。此外，第 4 代相機世代中帶有或不帶有藍色條紋的車輛皆有混用，而新車上出現藍色條紋的情況更為常見。
備註：由於來自義大利等其他歐盟國家的遊客到訪，沿海地區更常看到藍色條紋。

text: Curaçao uses square licence plates that appear completely white through the blur.
NOTE: While front plates are mandatory, a [minority](https://goo.gl/maps/rXKj6bBALkcMM5Cg9) will still not have front plates.
text_zh: 庫拉索使用方形車牌，經過模糊處理後看起來完全是白色的。
注意：雖然強制規定懸掛前車牌，但仍有[少數](https://goo.gl/maps/rXKj6bBALkcMM5Cg9)車輛沒有前車牌。

text: Cyprus uses both standard **white** European license plates, and UK-style plates that have a **yellow rear plate**. Most license plates have the EU strip on the left. Rental cars, which have a distinct **red** plate, are not uncommon either.
text_zh: 賽普勒斯同時使用標準的**白色**歐洲車牌，以及帶有**黃色後車牌**的英式車牌。大多數車牌左側都有歐盟條帶。帶有獨特**紅色**車牌的租賃車也很常見。

text: DR licence plates are somewhat reminiscent of New Jersey plates, being pale **yellow **at the top and **white **at the bottom.
NOTE: The Dominican Republic is the only part of Latin America, apart from Puerto Rico and Panama, where front plates are not required.
text_zh: 多明尼加車牌有點讓人想起紐澤西州的車牌，頂端是淡**黃色**，底部是**白色**。
注意：多明尼加共和國是拉丁美洲除了波多黎各和巴拿馬之外，唯一不需要前車牌的地方。

text: The standard licence plates are white and can be **short or long**. In street view, you will often see a mix of both sizes.

Commercial vehicles, such as taxis or buses, can have older [solid orange](https://goo.gl/maps/QHw5nYaBYjsWqeNo7) plates, or newer ones with an [orange bar](https://goo.gl/maps/F5SCJqkGQ7QFR9kb7) at the top.
NOTE: Ecuador is the only country in Latin America to use a mix of short and long licence plates.
text_zh: 標準車牌是白色的，可以是**短的或長的**。在街景中，你經常會看到兩種尺寸混合的情況。
計程車或公車等營業用車，可能擁有較舊的[純橘色](https://goo.gl/maps/QHw5nYaBYjsWqeNo7)車牌，或是頂端帶有[橘色條紋](https://goo.gl/maps/F5SCJqkGQ7QFR9kb7)的新式車牌。
注意：厄瓜多是拉丁美洲唯一同時使用長短車牌混合的國家。

text: Taxis in Ecuador are very common, and the **first letter** on each taxi can be used to determine the province you are in. The first letter of the taxi and the first letter of the province name are often the same.

NOTE: This letter will also appear as the first letter on ordinary licence plates respectively in each region. Beware that the letter P, as the letter for Pichincha (the region containing Quito), shows up occasionally in several regions.
text_zh: 厄瓜多常看到計程車，每輛計程車上的**第一個字母**可用來判斷你所在的省份。計程車的第一個字母通常與省份名稱的第一個字母相同。
注意：這個字母也會分別出現在各個地區一般車牌的第一個字母。請注意，作為皮欽查省（包含基多的省份）代號的字母 P，偶爾也會出現在好幾個地區。

text: Estonian **licence plates** are long and white, with the standard blue European strip on the left.
text_zh: 愛沙尼亞的**車牌**是長條白色，左側帶有標準的藍色歐洲標誌條。

text: Licence plates in Eswatini are **long** and **green at the bottom**.
NOTE: These may look similar to certain South African plates. Make sure to refer to other clues before guessing.
text_zh: 史瓦帝尼的車牌是**長形**的，且**底部為綠色**。
注意：這些車牌看起來可能與某些南非車牌相似。在猜測之前，請務必參考其他線索。

text: Licence plates on Åland are white with blue text, making them appear almost completely white on Street View. They are noticeably quite **short** and **lack** the European blue strip on the left side.
text_zh: 奧蘭的車牌是白底藍字，這使得它們在街景服務上看起來幾乎完全是白色的。它們明顯相當**短**，且**缺少**左側的歐盟藍色條帶。

text: Each German state also has their own coat of arms. They are found on unblurred licence plates and some official buildings.
text_zh: 德國每個邦也都有自己的邦徽。它們可以在未模糊的車牌和一些官方建築上找到。

text: Greek licence plates are either **all white** or have the **standard European design**, with a blue strip on the left side. Taxis have yellow licence plates.
text_zh: 希臘車牌要麼**全白**，要麼採用**標準歐洲設計**，左側帶有藍色條紋。計程車則使用黃色車牌。

text: Guatemala has short licence plates, which when blurred will typically have either a blue tinge, or a hint of green on the left side.
text_zh: 瓜地馬拉的車牌較短，當它模糊不清時，通常左側會帶有藍色色調或一抹綠色。

text: The most common Hawaii licence plate is **white** with an **arcing rainbow** across the centre of the plate. When blurred, you can sometimes see the outline of the rainbow. Front plates are required in Hawaii.
text_zh: 最常見的夏威夷車牌是**白色**的，車牌正中央有一道**成弧形的彩虹**。當影像模糊時，有時可以看到彩虹的輪廓。夏威夷規定必須懸掛前車牌。

text: Hong Kong has **white **front licence plates and **yellow **rear** **licence plates. The licence plates can be long or short. Some cars have an additional [black](https://maps.app.goo.gl/cyTzqwmo1qrNYJxZ9) mainland Chinese licence plate.
text_zh: 香港的前車牌為**白色**，後車牌為**黃色**。車牌可以是長形或短形。有些車輛還附帶一面[黑色](https://maps.app.goo.gl/cyTzqwmo1qrNYJxZ9)的中國大陸車牌。

text: Hungary uses **long white** standard European licence plates. Taxi licence plates are **yellow.**
In July of 2022, Hungary switched to this new character format, which contains the coat of arms.
NOTE: Newer electric vehicles have green plates.
text_zh: 匈牙利使用**長型白色**的標準歐洲車牌。計程車車牌為**黃色**。
在 2022 年 7 月，匈牙利換成了這種包含國徽的新字體格式。
注意：較新的電動車擁有綠色車牌。

text: Icelandic licence plates are **fully white with blue characters**. Unlike most of Europe, the plates do not feature a blue strip on the left.
It can be hard to see the blue of the characters through the blur of the plates.
text_zh: 冰島的車牌為**全白且帶有藍色字體**。不同於大多數歐洲國家，其車牌左側沒有藍色條紋。
透過車牌的模糊效果，可能很難看清楚藍色字體。

text: Indian licence plates are typically fairly long, with the most common design being white. Commercial vehicles typically use yellow plates, while electric vehicles use green.
text_zh: 印度車牌通常相當長，最常見的設計是白色。商業車輛通常使用黃色車牌，電動車則使用綠色。

text: Ireland has long, **white** licence plates with the standard European **blue strip** on the left.
The white backplate is especially useful to distinguish it from the UK, which uses yellow backplates (but white fronts). In addition, most UK vehicles lack the blue strip on the left.
text_zh: 愛爾蘭擁有長型的**白色**車牌，左側有標準的歐洲**藍色條紋**。
白色的後車牌特別有助於將其與英國區分開來，英國使用的是黃色後車牌（但前車牌是白色）。此外，大多數英國車輛左側沒有藍色條紋。

text: Similar to the United Kingdom, the Isle of Man uses white front licence plates with yellow rears, but with a **red strip** on the left.
text_zh: 與英國相似，曼島使用白色的前車牌和黃色的後車牌，但左側帶有一條**紅色條紋**。

text: Israeli licence plates are **yellow **with a blue strip on the left.
NOTE: While this design is specific for Israel, it is also very common on the West Bank. Jordan and the UAE use white licence plates. Tunisia uses black plates.
text_zh: 以色列車牌是**黃色**的，左側有一條藍色條紋。
NOTE: 雖然這種設計是以色列特有的，但在約旦河西岸也非常普遍。約旦和阿拉伯聯合大公國使用白色車牌。突尼西亞使用黑色車牌。

text: Licence plates in the West Bank are often [white](/images/israel-west-bank/ps_licenceplate1.png) with green text, often giving blurred plates a slight green tint. On public transport vehicles, such as taxis and buses, the colours will be inverted; [green](/images/israel-west-bank/ps_licenceplate2.png) with white text, making blurred plates almost completely green.
Beware that Israeli licence plates are also very common in most of the West Bank.
text_zh: 約旦河西岸的車牌通常是[白色](https://maps.google.com/images/israel-west-bank/ps_licenceplate1.png)配綠色文字，這通常會讓模糊的車牌帶有一點綠色。在計程車和公車等大眾運輸工具上，顏色會顛倒過來；變成[綠色](https://maps.google.com/images/israel-west-bank/ps_licenceplate2.png)配白色文字，這使得模糊的車牌幾乎完全變成綠色。
請注意，以色列車牌在約旦河西岸大部分地區也非常普遍。

text: This **larger white** Citroën follow car with a **West Bank licence plate** can be found in a region surrounding Jerusalem. It is noticeably found in the cities of Bethlehem and Ramallah.

NOTE: The [side](https://goo.gl/maps/CyZBjDakijcXH87L6) of this car features the text “SECURITY” in a bold font. Furthermore, this coverage will always feature a black Street View car with [no antenna](https://goo.gl/maps/qSquP511uzs7bk9o6).
text_zh: 這台帶有**約旦河西岸車牌**的**較大型白色**雪鐵龍（Citroën）跟拍車可以在耶路撒冷周邊地區找到。它特別常見於伯利恆（Bethlehem）和雷姆拉（Ramallah）等城市。
注意：這台車的[側面](https://goo.gl/maps/CyZBjDakijcXH87L6)印有粗體字「SECURITY」。此外，這種拍攝畫質將始終包含一台[沒有天線](https://goo.gl/maps/qSquP511uzs7bk9o6)的黑色 Google 車。

text: Japan uses a standard **short white** licence plate with green text. You will often see a different short yellow version with black text issued to “light automobiles”, otherwise known as Kei Cars.
text_zh: 日本的標準車牌是**短版白底**配綠字。另外常見一種短版黃底黑字的車牌，發給「輕自動車」，也就是俗稱的 K-Car。

text: Jersey licence plates follow the British model, having a long **white front** and **yellow rear** plate. In addition, you will notice the island’s red coat of arms on the left, as well as the letter ‘J’ at the beginning of all codes in unblurred plates.
NOTE: In contrast to the British mainland, Jersey was never a member of the European Union. This means that local plates do not have a blue strip.
text_zh: 澤西島車牌遵循英國模式，具有長條形的**白色前車牌**和**黃色後車牌**。此外，你會注意到左側有該島的紅色徽章，且在清晰未模糊的車牌上，所有代碼開頭都有一個「J」字。
註：與英國本土不同，澤西島從未加入歐盟。這意味著當地車牌沒有藍色邊條。

text: Jordanian licence plates are **white** and can be long or short. Commercial transport vehicles, such as taxis, have a distinctive **green strip** on the left.
NOTE: In the Middle East, the green strip is only found in Jordan.
The UAE also uses long white plates. Israel however only uses yellow licence plates. In Palestine, both white domestic and yellow Israeli plates are common.
text_zh: 約旦車牌是**白色**的，可以長牌或短牌。計程車等商業運輸車輛在左側有一個明顯的**綠色邊條**。
註：在中東，綠色邊條僅見於約旦。
阿拉伯聯合大公國也使用長白牌。然而以色列只使用黃色車牌。在巴勒斯坦，白色國內車牌和黃色以色列車牌都很常見。

text: When blurred, the standard Kazakh licence plates are mostly white, with a small hint of blue on the left side.
text_zh: 當模糊時，標準的哈薩克車牌大多是白色的，左側帶有一點藍色。

text: You can occasionally spot licence plate codes on the back of [trucks](https://maps.app.goo.gl/tKZW4WNWfm8LC6Bf8) and [buses](https://goo.gl/maps/ShsB6GNeCf3cp4gB6). The codes themselves follow an alphabetical order, with smaller numbers corresponding to regions that start with earlier letters. Note that cars do travel, and as such not all codes are reliable. Buses and smaller utility vehicles are the most reliable.
text_zh: 你偶爾可以在[卡車](https://maps.app.goo.gl/tKZW4WNWfm8LC6Bf8)和[公車](https://goo.gl/maps/ShsB6GNeCf3cp4gB6)背面發現車牌代碼。這些代碼本身遵循字母順序，較小的數字對應到字母開頭較早的地區。請注意，車輛是會移動的，因此並非所有代碼都可靠。公車和小型商用車最為可靠。

text: Licence plates in Kyrgyzstan have a **red strip** on them.
NOTE: Licence plates with red strips can sometimes be seen in Albania and very rarely in the UAE.
text_zh: 吉爾吉斯車牌上有**紅色條紋**。
注意：阿爾巴尼亞有時，阿拉伯聯合大公國極少數情況下，也能見到帶有紅條的車牌。

text: Laotian licence plates are short and **yellow**. This distinguishes them from nearby Thailand and Cambodia, who both use white plates on non-commercial vehicles.
Laotian commercial plates are white, and government plates are blue.
NOTE: Thailand uses yellow plates for commercial vehicles, such as taxis.
text_zh: 寮國車牌很短且呈**黃色**。這使它們與鄰近的泰國和柬埔寨區分開來，這兩國的非營業車輛都使用白牌。
寮國的營業車牌是白色的，政府車牌則是藍色的。
註記：泰國的營業車輛（例如計程車）使用黃牌。

text: Latvian **licence plates** are long and white, with the standard blue European strip on the left.
text_zh: 拉脫維亞**車牌**又長又白，左側有標準的藍色歐洲條紋。

text: Standard Lebanese licence plates are either long with a blue strip on the left, similar to most licence plates in Europe, or **short** with a similar blue strip. Licence plates on taxis are notably **deep red**. You may also find licence plates with [other colours](https://goo.gl/maps/oQN6Fvb8y2GSypoC6).
text_zh: 標準的黎巴嫩車牌是長形且左側帶有藍條（類似多數歐洲車牌），或是**短形**且帶有類似的藍條。計程車的車牌則是顯眼的**深紅色**。你 também 可能會找到[其他顏色](https://goo.gl/maps/oQN6Fvb8y2GSypoC6)的車牌。

text: Lesotho uses long white licence plates with **blue** text. If partially unblurred, you may see the [Mokorotlo hat](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mokorotlo) symbol on the left.
text_zh: 賴索托使用帶有**藍色**文字的長白車牌。如果部分未模糊，你可能會看到左側的[莫科羅特洛帽（Mokorotlo）](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mokorotlo)符號。

text: Lithuanian **licence plates** are long and white, with the standard blue European strip on the left.
text_zh: 立陶宛的**車牌**又長又白，左側有標準的藍色歐洲條紋。

text: In Generation 3 coverage, you will often see **random small blurs**. These blurs look similar to the ones that are used to blur out licence plates or faces, but instead they cover seemingly random parts of the image – often on direction signs.
NOTE: This is also common in the Russian oblast of Kaliningrad, just to the southwest of Lithuania.
!!These random blurs are not typically found in Estonia or Latvia.
text_zh: 在第三代（Generation 3）街景覆蓋中，你經常會看到**隨機的小模糊**。這些模糊看起來類似於用來遮蔽車牌或人臉的模糊，但它們遮蔽的卻是畫面中看似隨機的部分——通常在指示牌上。
注意：這在立陶宛西南方的俄羅斯加里寧格勒州也很常見。
!!這些隨機模糊通常不會出現在愛沙尼亞或拉脫維亞。

text: Almost all of Luxembourg’s landscape consists of green **rolling hills**, with a patchwork of agriculture and forests.
NOTE: If you see a yellow licence plate, and you are not sure what country it belongs to, landscape is often a good clue: almost all of the Netherlands is completely flat.
text_zh: 盧森堡的景觀幾乎全由綠色**起伏丘陵**組成，夾雜著農田和森林。
NOTE: 如果你看到黃色車牌，且不確定它屬於哪個國家，風景通常是一個很好的線索：荷蘭幾乎完全是平地。

text: Macau uses **black** licence plates with **white** text. Licence plates can either be long or square.
text_zh: 澳門使用**黑色**車牌配上**白色**文字。車牌可以是長形或方形。

text: Like most of Europe, Maltese licence plates have a blue strip on the left. However, unlike most of Europe, **short plates** are very common.
text_zh: 就像大多數歐洲國家一樣，馬爾他車牌左側有一條藍色飾帶。然而，與大多數歐洲國家不同的是，**短車牌**非常常見。

text: Mexico uses short licence plates with a large variety of designs. Front plates are required.
NOTE: For an overview of the most common regional designs, see step 2.
text_zh: 墨西哥使用短車牌，有著多種不同的設計。強制規定要有前車牌。
注意：若要概覽最常見的地區設計，請參見步驟 2。

text: Every state in Mexico has one or several unique licence plate designs. In this infographic you can find the most common and helpful ones.
text_zh: 墨西哥每個州都有一個或多個獨特的車牌設計。在這張資訊圖表中，你可以找到最常見和最有用的車牌。

text: Monaco’s licence plates are **short** and lack the blue strip.
You will still see a lot of normal French plates around, however. These French vehicles often still have the old yellow back plates, due to how old the Generation 2 coverage is.
text_zh: 摩納哥的車牌很**短**，且缺少藍色條紋。
不過，你仍然會看到許多法國的普通車牌。由於第二代街景的年代久遠，這些法國車輛通常仍帶有舊的黃色後車牌。

text: Mongolian licence plates are mostly white with a hint of **red** on the left side from the [Soyombo symbol](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Soyombo_symbol).
text_zh: 蒙古車牌大多是白色的，左側帶有一點[索永布符號](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Soyombo_symbol)的**紅色**。

text: Namibia primarily uses yellow front and back licence plates. Vanity plates are white, with blue lettering.
NOTE: Botswana and Namibia are the only countries in southern Africa where yellow rear plates are predominantly found.
text_zh: 納米比亞的車牌前後皆主要使用黃色。個性化車牌則是白色，搭配藍色字體。
註：波札那是與納米比亞是非洲南部唯二主要使用黃色後車牌的國家。

text: Nepali licence plates are typically fairly long, with the most common design being white. Private vehicles use red plates, while public vehicles use black ones.
text_zh: 尼泊爾車牌通常相當長，最常見的設計是白色。私人車輛使用紅色車牌，公共車輛則使用黑色車牌。

text: The Netherlands has long, **yellow licence plates** with the standard European blue strip on the left. Dutch taxis have blue plates.

NOTE: The only other countries in Europe with yellow licence plates are Luxembourg and the UK. For the UK, only the back plates are yellow, and they often lack the blue strip. In addition, some older coverage in France features the French yellow back plates. In Denmark, you can find yellow plates on commercial vehicles.
text_zh: 荷蘭擁有長型的**黃色車牌**，左側帶有標準的歐洲藍色邊條。荷蘭的計程車則使用藍色車牌。
注意：歐洲其他使用黃色車牌的國家只有盧森堡和英國。就英國而言，只有後車牌是黃色的，且通常沒有藍色邊條。此外，法國的一些舊街景中也有法國黃色後車牌。在丹麥，商用車上也可以看到黃色車牌。

text: New Zealand uses **white** licence plates with **black text**, which appears mostly white through the blur.
NOTE: Some vehicles have custom licence plates which make the sides of the licence plate appear blue or black.
text_zh: 紐西蘭使用**白色**車牌搭配**黑色文字**，透過模糊效果看起來大多是白色的。
注意：有些車輛使用自訂車牌，會使車牌兩側看起來是藍色或黑色。

text: Nigeria uses short licence plates that appear somewhat **green** through the blur.
text_zh: 奈及利亞使用較短的車牌，透過模糊看起來帶有些許**綠色**。

text: Norway has long white licence plates with the standard European strip on the left.
Commercial plates are **green**. These are often seen on vans.
NOTE: Within Europe, green licence plates are most commonly seen in Norway, but can also be found on electric vehicles in several other countries.
text_zh: 挪威擁有白色長車牌，左側帶有標準的歐洲條紋。
商業車牌是**綠色**的。這些經常出現在廂型車上。
注意：在歐洲境內，綠色車牌最常見於挪威，但在其他幾個國家也能在電動車上找到。

text: Licence plates on private vehicles are generally yellow, while commercial vehicles have red plates.
text_zh: 私人車輛的車牌通常是黃色的，而商業車輛則是紅色的。

text: Pakistan uses **short** licence plates and each region has its unique design. However, as all of the coverage was taken in Punjab, most plates will have the Punjab design, with a **green strip** on the left side. [Fully green plates](https://www.google.com/maps/@31.5699275,74.3126068,2a,15y,346.42h,75.04t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sFje7OKBVT_esVcdJIZy0BQ!2e0!7i13312!8i6656?entry=ttu) are also fairly common.
NOTE: India primarily uses long licence plates.
text_zh: 巴基斯坦使用**短**車牌，每個地區都有其獨特的設計。然而，由於所有街景覆蓋都是在旁遮普拍攝的，大多數車牌都會採用旁遮普設計，左側有一條**綠色帶子**。[全綠車牌](https://www.google.com/maps/@31.5699275,74.3126068,2a,15y,346.42h,75.04t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sFje7OKBVT_esVcdJIZy0BQ!2e0!7i13312!8i6656?entry=ttu)也相當常見。
注意：印度主要使用長車牌。

text: **Yellow **taxis with a **chequerboard patterned horizontal stripe** are a common sight in Panama. The licence plate will be drawn on the side, containing the city name and a [regional code](/panama#taxiplates).
text_zh: 在巴拿馬，帶有**棋盤格圖案水平條紋**的**黃色**計程車是很常見的景象。車牌會被繪製在車身側面，包含城市名稱和[地區代碼](/panama#taxiplates)。

text: Peruvian licence plates are either **white** or **yellow**. In contrast to the white plates, yellow plates are less likely to be seen.
Additionally, taxis in Peru typically use licence plates that are [**yellow on the top and white on the bottom**](https://maps.app.goo.gl/K8u6wZg1kdNcwaKs6).
NOTE: Within South America, yellow licence plates are **only** found in Peru, Colombia and rarely, Chile.
text_zh: 祕魯車牌不是**白色**就是**黃色**。與白色車牌相比，黃色車牌較少見。
此外，祕魯的出租車通常使用[**上黃下白**](https://maps.app.goo.gl/K8u6wZg1kdNcwaKs6)的車牌。
注意：在南美洲中，黃色車牌**僅**見於祕魯、哥倫比亞，以及極少數的智利。

text: Standard white licence plates with black text are used for passenger vehicles. You can also find many older plates from the 2002 series, which are recognisable due to their **green tint**.
text_zh: 載客車輛使用標準白底黑字的車牌。你也可以找到許多 2002 年系列的舊車牌，其特徵是帶有 **綠色色調**。

text: Regular cars in Qatar have **long, white** licence plates with a **maroon** strip on the left. Trucks have **square, black** licence plates and police plates are blue.
text_zh: 卡達的一般車輛擁有 **長型、白色** 的車牌，左側帶有 **栗色** 條紋。卡車則有 **方形、黑色** 車牌，警車車牌則是藍色的。

text: In Generation 3 coverage you will somewhat commonly find unblurred licence plates, featuring a **regional code** on the right side. The codes are generally ordered alphabetically within each [type of federal subject](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Federal_subjects_of_Russia#Types), starting at republics and ending with autonomous okrugs. Therefore, the [Republic of Adygea](https://maps.app.goo.gl/PhX9zVnMQfBCvHQi7) will be represented by 01, and the [Amur Oblast](https://maps.app.goo.gl/AXNwmSJ1vio1pRCo7) by 28, both being the first alphabetical subjects of republics and oblasts respectively. If you encounter a [three digit code](https://maps.app.goo.gl/BiQGFQEG51Xxc7fc7), the second and third digit will form the regional code, in this case 123 becomes 23, for Krasnodar Krai. You may also find the codes written out on the back of [trucks](https://maps.app.goo.gl/NVQNyKpSUXZ3i4LG6) and [vans](https://www.google.com/maps/@56.6511783,66.3012014,3a,15y,5.71h,78.8t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1s8nSDptPKXAhrtGZE6nzskg!2e0!7i13312!8i6656?entry=ttu).
text_zh: 在 Generation 3 街景中，你常會看到未模糊的車牌，其右側標有**區域代碼**。這些代碼通常在各個[聯邦主體類型](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Federal_subjects_of_Russia#Types)內按字母順序排列，從共和國開始，到自治區結束。因此，[阿迪格共和國](https://maps.app.goo.gl/PhX9zVnMQfBCvHQi7)會以 01 表示，而[阿穆爾州](https://maps.app.goo.gl/AXNwmSJ1vio1pRCo7)則以 28 表示，兩者分別為共和國和州按字母順序排列的第一個主體。如果你遇到[三位數代碼](https://maps.app.goo.gl/BiQGFQEG51Xxc7fc7)，第二和第三位數字將組成區域代碼，在此例中，123 變成克拉斯諾達爾邊疆區的 23。你也可以在[卡車](https://maps.app.goo.gl/NVQNyKpSUXZ3i4LG6)和[廂型車](https://www.google.com/maps/@56.6511783,66.3012014,3a,15y,5.71h,78.8t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1s8nSDptPKXAhrtGZE6nzskg!2e0!7i13312!8i6656?entry=ttu)的後方找到寫出來的代碼。

text: Licence plates can be either white or yellow and either short or long. They all have a blue EU strip however, and the white plates will also have a blue strip on the right, as is custom in France. Vehicles may or may not have front plates.
text_zh: 車牌可以是白色或黃色，也可以是短牌或長牌。然而，它們都有藍色歐盟標條，且白牌右側也會帶有藍色標條，這是法國的慣例。車輛可能裝有或未裝前車牌。

text: Sammarinese licence plates are **short**, **white** and have **blue lettering** on them.
NOTE: Other European countries will typically have **longer** licence plates, often with one or more **blue strips**.
text_zh: 聖馬利諾車牌很**短**、呈**白色**，上面有**藍色字體**。
注意：其他歐洲國家的車牌通常較**長**，且通常帶有一個或多個**藍色條紋**。

text: Senegal is the only African country to use fully **blue** licence plates. A newer version exists in Generation 4 which looks like the standard **European** licence plate which is white with a blue strip on the left.
text_zh: 塞內加爾是非洲唯一使用全**藍色**車牌的國家。第 4 代街景中存在較新的版本，看起來像標準的**歐洲**車牌，為白色且左側帶有藍色條紋。

text: Most Singaporean licence plates are **black, with white text**. Occasionally, you will be able to see the British style **white-and-yellow** plates and very rarely red plates.
NOTE: Neighbouring Malaysia and Indonesia also use black plates with white text. However, the letters will usually be divided into two or three sections - this is not the case for Singaporean plates.
text_zh: 大多數新加坡車牌是**黑底白字**。偶爾你會看到英式風格的**白黃相間**車牌，極少數情況下會看到紅色的車牌。
注意：鄰近的馬來西亞和印尼也使用黑底白字車牌。然而，它們的字母通常會分成兩到三個區段——新加坡車牌則非如此。

text: Each province features a **different **licence plate design, which can be somewhat visible through the blur. Most notably Free State or KwaZulu-Natal, which have a slight green tint and blue tint respectively.
_You can click on the image to enlarge it._
text_zh: 每個省份都有**不同的**車牌設計，透過模糊影像可以隱約看出。最顯著的是自由邦省或夸祖魯-納塔爾省，分別帶有微微的綠色調和藍色調。
_點擊圖片可放大。_

text: South Korea uses a variety of different licence plates.
- Pre-2006 plates are short and **green**. These will still show up in the street view coverage.
- Post-2006 plates are **white** for private vehicles, and **yellow** for commercial vehicles. These can be long and short.
text_zh: 南韓使用各種不同的車牌。
- 2006 年以前的車牌較短且為**綠色**。這些仍會出現在街景覆蓋中。
- 2006 年以後的車牌，私人車輛為**白色**，營業用車輛為**黃色**。這些車牌有長版和短版。

text: Licence plates in Svalbard are generally **black** with **yellow text**.
text_zh: 斯瓦巴的車牌通常是 **黑色** 配 **黃色字**。

text: Swedish **licence plates** are long, white, and have the standard blue EU strip on the left side. Licence plates on taxis have a yellow background instead of white.
text_zh: 瑞典**車牌**是長條狀的白色，左側有標準的藍色歐盟標誌條。計程車車牌的背景是黃色而非白色。

text: Swiss **licence plates** differ substantially from other European plates. They are fully white and lack the blue strip found in most other European countries.
**Front plates** are extremely short compared to most in Europe.
**Rear plates** can be either long or tall. In both cases the red country emblem can be seen on the left, while the canton emblem can be seen on the right.
text_zh: 瑞士**車牌**與其他歐洲車牌有很大不同。它們完全是白色的，且缺少大多數其他歐洲國家車牌上的藍色條紋。
與歐洲大多數車牌相比，**前車牌**極短。
**後車牌**可以是長的或高的。在這兩種情況下，紅色國家徽章都在左側，而州徽則在右側。

text: **Cantons** are the first-level administrative division of Switzerland. It is very common to find the two-letter abbreviation for the canton that you are in, as seen on some town entry signs. As such, remembering these can be a great asset when region-guessing Switzerland.
NOTE: If you happen to come across an [unblurred licence plate](https://maps.app.goo.gl/yi7rVDEFGXqwZaWSA), the first two letters will correspond to the canton that it is registered in.
text_zh: **州（Cantons）**是瑞士的第一級行政區劃。你經常可以在某些城鎮入口標誌上找到你所在州的兩位字母縮寫。因此，記住這些縮寫在進行瑞士區域猜測（region-guessing）時會是一大優勢。
註：如果你剛好遇到一個[未模糊的車牌](https://maps.app.goo.gl/yi7rVDEFGXqwZaWSA)，前兩個字母將對應到該車輛註冊的州。

text: Thailand uses large, **white** licence plates on **passenger vehicles**, and yellow ones on commercial vehicles.
NOTE: Within Southeast Asia, yellow commercial plates are only found in Thailand. Be careful, however, as Laos uses yellow licence plates for regular vehicles.
text_zh: 泰國在**乘用車**上使用大型的**白色**車牌，在營業用車上則使用黃色車牌。
註：在東南亞地區，黃色營業用車牌僅見於泰國。然而請注意，寮國的一般車輛也使用黃色車牌。

text: Tunisian licence plates are **black with white text**.
NOTE: Military plates feature a small Tunisian flag on the left side of the plate, which is visible on the dark green follow car.
text_zh: 突尼西亞車牌是**黑底白字**。
注意：軍用車牌在車牌左側有一個小型突尼西亞國旗，這可以在深綠色的跟拍車上看到。

text: The **dark green Mazda** is the most common follow car in Tunisia. This becomes apparent if you look at the coverage map, it can be found all the way from Hammamet to Djerba. Aside from the darker colour, it can also be recognized by its military licence plate with a **red strip** on the left.
text_zh: **深綠色 Mazda** 是突尼西亞最常見的跟拍車。如果你看街景覆蓋地圖就會發現，它從哈馬馬特一路延伸到傑爾巴島都能找到。除了顏色較深之外，它也可以透過左側帶有**紅色條紋**的軍用車牌來辨識。

text: Turkey uses the same licence plates as most of Europe: they are long and white, with a **blue strip** on the left.
text_zh: 土耳其使用的車牌與多數歐洲國家相同：它們是長形白底車牌，左側帶有**藍色條紋**。

text: Licence plates are short, typically either having a **bright blue** or a **dark blue** design.
text_zh: 車牌很短，通常採用**亮藍色**或**深藍色**設計。

text: Ukraine uses long, white licence plates, with a distinctive **blue and yellow** strip on the left (the colours of the flag).
You may also come across older plates, where the blue and yellow are difficult to spot.
NOTE: Russia uses fully white licence plates, without a strip on the left.
text_zh: 烏干達使用長型白底車牌，左側帶有鮮明的**藍黃相間**條紋（國旗的顏色）。
你也可能會遇到較舊的車牌，其上的藍色和黃色較難辨識。
注意：俄羅斯使用全白車牌，左側沒有條紋。

text: The first two letters on Ukrainian licence plates determine in which oblast the vehicle is registered in, making unblurred licence plates very useful for regionguessing. Unlike most regional plates in Europe, they’re not intuitive, so learning the codes beforehand is essential for utilising them.

NOTE: The map shown only applies to the most recent and common plates, with a [blue and yellow strip](https://maps.app.goo.gl/JBdhZAFtT8ad6JXX8). The [older plates](https://maps.app.goo.gl/xT84P2MZ6J22UtxB8) use a regional [number code](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Vehicle_registration_plates_of_Ukraine#Regional_codes), similar to Russia.
text_zh: 烏克蘭車牌上的前兩個字母決定了車輛是在哪個州註冊的，這使得未模糊的車牌對於區域猜測非常有用。與歐洲大多數區域車牌不同，它們並不直觀，因此事先學習代碼對於利用它們至關重要。

備註：顯示的地圖僅適用於最新且最常見的車牌，帶有[藍黃相間的條紋](https://maps.app.goo.gl/JBdhZAFtT8ad6JXX8)。[較舊的車牌](https://maps.app.goo.gl/xT84P2MZ6J22UtxB8)使用類似俄羅斯的區域[數字代碼](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Vehicle_registration_plates_of_Ukraine#Regional_codes)。

text: Uruguayan **licence plates** are plain white with black characters.
NOTE: Neighbouring Argentina also uses white licence plates, but they will have either a black dot in the middle or a blue bar at the top.
text_zh: 烏拉圭的**車牌**是全白底黑字。
注意：鄰國阿根廷也使用白色車牌，但它們的中間有一個黑點或頂部有一條藍帶。

text: Vietnamese licence plates are **white** with black lettering. Both long and short versions are in use.
text_zh: 越南車牌是**白色**配黑色字體。長版和短版皆有使用。

text: Vietnamese licence plate codes, which are often painted onto the sides of trucks and other vehicles, are another useful clue to figure out the region.
text_zh: 越南車牌代碼經常被漆在卡車和其他車輛的側面，是找出所在地區的另一項有用線索。

intro.lead: 車牌的底色與比例，遠遠就看得出來
body: 即使模糊到看不清字，車牌的長寬比例、底色與邊框顏色仍然可讀。歐盟車牌左側有藍條、荷蘭是黃底、英國前白後黃、部分美洲國家使用方形車牌。
跟車流一起看效果最好：路上多數車輛的車牌形式一致，比單看一台車可靠。
